charge_port.notes: Subaru 2027 kit: all 2027 Solterra models feature a NACS port.

supercharger_access.notes: Subaru 2027 kit: the NACS-port Solterra gives 'access to more than 25,000 charging stations'; the Oct 2025 Subaru release says all Solterra owners have access to 25,000+ Tesla Superchargers.

Subaru USA 2026 release: the NACS-port Solterra has access to more than 15,000 Tesla Superchargers; the Oct 2025 release says all Solterra owners have access to 25,000+; 2027 kit: NACS port gives 'access to more than 25,000 charging stations'.
